2.16.25
Textbox.UserSort
Applies to RDL 2005/01, RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Textbox.UserSort element specifies an end-user sort control that is displayed as part of a
Textbox within the UI. This element is optional. This element is of type UserSort.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.UserSort element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.UserSort element.
 <xsd:element name="UserSort" type="UserSortType" minOccurs="0" />
